title: Reasonable > Rational
supportedClaims: The best money plan is often the one you can live with consistently, even if a model says another plan is more efficient.
People need strategies that fit their temperament, sleep, attention, and risk tolerance because panic can destroy theoretically superior plans.
The practical move is to prefer workable commitments over brittle optimization and to judge plans by durability, not just elegance.
caution: Reasonable should not become an excuse for laziness or denial. It is a standard of fit, not a permission slip for avoidance.
